title: Eightfold adaptation manifest
description: Manifest for a single Eightfold adaptation. Lives at the root of an adaptation branch as eightfold.json.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the manifest format. Bump only on breaking changes.

entry.description: Path to the adaptation entry point, relative to the branch root.

permissions.description: Permissions the adaptation may request. Known values include filesystem, network, browser, shell, git, docker, credentials, email, and calendar.

dependencies.description: Ids of other adaptations this adaptation depends on.
